review.posthog_relevance: Adds statistical analysis support and metadata tracking to the Experiment Results retrieval and UI routing, potentially improving result interpretation and debugging.
review.reason: The observed changes replace the `ExperimentExposure` interface with `ExperimentVariantStats`, adding Bayesian and frequentist statistics, p-values, and confidence intervals, and update metadata/status fields. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for PostHog's Experiment Results feature, allowing users to interpret statistical significance and reliability.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and validation of these statistical calculations are not fully demonstrated in the provided hunk descriptions; the benefit relies on the correctness of the added fields and their integration, which is not independently verified. No tier assignment is performed here; only observations are recorded.
